name: Briar Wolf
notes: Briar Wolves (story bible §8, style bible §5.2: low horizontal wedge). Quadruped agent 0.4 m radius, 0.9 m tall. Fast walkers: trot 1.8, stalk 1.2 and a 9 m/s run (real wolves sprint 13–18 m/s; capped so the player can reach a door or climb in time). Nimble on the ground: 0.4 m steps, 50° slopes, 1.2 m jumps, 2.5 m drops. They cannot climb at all and cannot open doors, so height and a closed door are the answer to a pack. They wade to 0.7 m and swim reluctantly (surface only, 1.5× cost in shallows, 4× in deep water).
